# fairtrade design system

> One design system for peasant and village (the transcript viewer and trajectory graph ship from
> this package too): square, token-driven, two
> themes (deep dark + truly-white light), neuroinclusive by default, calm desaturated earthy
> palette with amber as a scarce accent. Built with React 19 + Tailwind v4; documented in a
> single-page site and a Storybook component library. Paths below are repo-relative; read
> AGENTS.md first for the hard invariants.

## start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): stack, commands, and the hard rules every change must respect.
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing overview and quick start.
- [public/tokens.json](public/tokens.json): all design tokens (colour both themes, spacing, type, motion) in DTCG shape; generated.
- [public/components.json](public/components.json): the component manifest (name, category, props, controls, stories); generated.

## design reference
- [llm/DESIGN.md](llm/DESIGN.md): the system - philosophy, tokens, typography, iconography, voice, component families.
- [llm/NEUROINCLUSIVE.md](llm/NEUROINCLUSIVE.md): the neuroinclusive defaults baked into the tokens (the why, with the WCAG / COGA sources).

## using it
- Import components from the `src/ui` barrel; they emit token-styled classes from `src/index.css`.
- Never hardcode a colour or size - reference a token. Keep both themes and WCAG AA contrast.
- Name a company with its real logo via `<BrandMark name="claude|gemini|openai|cursor|opencode" />`.
- `public/tokens.json` + `public/components.json` are generated; run `node scripts/gen-llm-artifacts.mjs` (never hand-edit).
